subject: Startups
title: When Users Become the Product
description: A quick, practical guide to When Users Become the Product.

hook.text: Facebook is free. So is Google. The catch: if you're not paying for the product, you are the product.

buildup.text: Ad-driven growth models need massive user bases. More users means more data means better ad targeting.

discovery.text: Cambridge Analytica harvested 87 million Facebook profiles without consent. Growth had outpaced privacy safeguards.

twist.text: Users didn't know their data was the business model.

climax.text: Growing backlash led to regulations, hearings, and fines. The 'move fast and break things' era broke public trust.

punchline.text: Free products are expensive. Users pay with data.

quiz.question: What was the Cambridge Analytica scandal about?
options: Harvesting millions of Facebook profiles without consent
Selling user passwords on the dark web
